concerns.text: SC‑005 requires reporting the speedup of the static‑feature pipeline relative to the ACE‑Ego‑0 baseline (5 min CPU per hour of video). No task in tasks.md measures or records this speedup; T013 only asserts absolute CPU‑time and RAM limits. Add a task (e.g., T016) that computes the CPU‑minutes‑per‑hour‑video for the static pipeline, compares it to the 5 min baseline, and writes the percentage speedup to `results/performance_metrics.txt`.
